body:
Industrial Vacuum Buffer Tank

Product Overview

The Industrial Vacuum Buffer Tank, also known as a Vacuum Receiver Tank or Vacuum Surge Vessel, is designed to stabilize vacuum pressure, minimize pressure fluctuations, and improve the operational reliability of industrial vacuum systems.

TONGYANG Process provides customized vacuum buffer tanks for chemical processing, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, and other industrial applications. These vessels serve as intermediate storage and buffering units between vacuum pumps and process equipment, helping maintain consistent vacuum conditions during continuous or intermittent operations.

Manufactured from stainless steel 304, 316L, carbon steel, or other suitable materials, our vacuum buffer tanks can be customized according to specific operating pressures, temperatures, capacities, and process requirements.

Optional gas-liquid separation, condensate collection, and monitoring instruments can be integrated to meet different industrial operating conditions.

Key Features and Advantages

1. Reliable Vacuum Stabilization

  • Reduces sudden vacuum pressure fluctuations.

  • Supports stable operation of vacuum pumps and connected process equipment.

  • Suitable for various industrial vacuum systems.

2. Durable Vessel Construction

  • Available in SS304, SS316L, carbon steel, and customized materials.

  • Designed for specified vacuum conditions and external pressure loads.

  • Reliable welded construction and quality inspection.

3. Flexible Customization

  • Vertical or horizontal configurations.

  • Customized capacities, dimensions, and nozzle arrangements.

  • Optional pressure gauges, vacuum transmitters, and drainage systems.

  • Optional gas-liquid separation and condensate collection functions.

4. Quality Manufacturing

  • Design and fabrication according to applicable ASME or Chinese pressure vessel standards.

  • Material inspection, welding examination, and testing according to project requirements.

  • Customized manufacturing and OEM services available.

Working Principle

A vacuum buffer tank is typically installed between process equipment and a vacuum pump. It provides additional gas volume to minimize rapid pressure changes and maintain stable vacuum conditions.

During operation, the vacuum pump continuously removes gas from the connected system. The buffer tank helps reduce pressure fluctuations caused by varying gas flow rates or intermittent process operations.

When equipped with suitable separation components, the vessel can also collect condensate and entrained liquids, helping protect downstream vacuum equipment.

Industrial Applications

Industrial Vacuum Buffer Tanks are suitable for a wide range of applications, including:

  • Chemical Processing: Vacuum distillation, evaporation, and solvent recovery.

  • Petrochemical Industry: Vacuum processing and gas buffering systems.

  • Pharmaceutical Industry: Vacuum drying and chemical intermediate production.

  • Polymer & Resin Industry: Vacuum degassing and resin processing.

  • Industrial Vacuum Systems: Vacuum pump stations, filtration systems, and centralized vacuum applications.

Customized Vacuum Buffer Tank Solutions

TONGYANG Process offers customized vacuum buffer tanks and industrial process vessels to meet different project requirements.

Our equipment solutions include customized materials, vessel dimensions, nozzle configurations, operating conditions, and optional instrumentation.

With manufacturing expertise in pressure vessels, storage tanks, reactors, and heat exchangers, we support industrial equipment projects with reliable fabrication, quality inspection, and technical documentation.

Custom designs and OEM manufacturing are available.
